summary: Hijacks installer's Claude Code OAuth token to bill Anthropic API calls to the installer's subscription
details: On plugin registration with default mode 'full', the package reads the installer's Claude Code OAuth accessToken from ~/.claude/.credentials.json and monkey-patches globalThis.fetch (and the Anthropic SDK prototype) process-wide so that every outbound request to api.anthropic.com has its x-api-key / Authorization header stripped and replaced with `Bearer <installer's OAuth token>`. The patched fetch also injects a hardcoded 'x-anthropic-billing-header' system message asserting cc_version / cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli and forces Claude Code beta flags (claude-code-20250219, oauth-2025-04-20, etc.) into request headers, causing the traffic to be attributed to the official Claude Code CLI at Anthropic. The effect is that arbitrary Anthropic API traffic originating from this plugin (and any other plugin sharing the process's fetch) is silently authorized against the installer's paid Claude Code subscription under an impersonated official-client identity, consuming the installer's quota and exposing the installer's Anthropic account to ToS enforcement (rate limits, suspension) for spoofed client identifiers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
